newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Mondragon - Sun Hung Kai.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Mondragon - Sun Hung Kai.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phil) Inc recommended a buy on Mondragon International Philippines Inc on Tuesday citing expected higher earnings for 1996 and the lifting of a closure order on its casino.

The brokerage house said in a research paper that Mondragon merited a buy on the company's estimates of a 1996 net income of 430 million pesos, up 99 percent from the previous year's 216 million pesos.
Sun Hung Kai said Mondragon's Mimosa Regency Casino at the Clark special economic zone, north of Manila, had been accepted by the market.
It had conributed 81 million pesos in the first three months of operations during the last quarter of 1996, the brokerage firm said.

Last week, the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp (Pagcor) ordered the closure of the Mimosa casino. Pagcor, which operates a casino near the Clark zone, said Mondragon had violated provisions of its permit and accused Mondragon of poaching Pagcor's players.
"The issue is minor/petty as this is a case of divergent interpretations of a specific clause in the contract," said Sun Hung Kai.
The closure order was lifted last Friday as Pagcor and Mondragon agreed to submit their differences to an arbitration committee.

Sun Hung Kai said the company's decision to concentrate on its resort and gaming investments by spinning off its consumer product business this year will remove the drain the retail business has imposed on Mondragon.
